name: gradient-button
blurb: Pill button with drifting gradient border.
description: A button with an animated linear gradient border using animate-gradient-x keyframes, wrapping a soft inner background.
use_when: You need a polished primary CTA with subtle continuous motion.
avoid_when: When animation must be minimal or on sites with many animated elements.
a11y: Standard button semantics with focus-visible ring. No prefers-reduced-motion guard; animation is always on.
